exp_function_classify_growth_decay.display_name: Classify f(x) = a * b^x as growth or decay and find initial value

easy.statement_latex: Classify $f(x) = 6 \cdot \dfrac{2}{3}^{x}$ as exponential growth or exponential decay, and state its initial value $f(0)$.
